evidenceConflict.detail: Within current official UE 5.8 documentation, the generated UMaterialExpressionVolumetricAdvancedMaterialOutput API/header tooltip and the Volumetric Cloud Component Properties page describe PhaseG g<0 as forward and g>0 as backward, while the official Volumetric Cloud Material page describes positive Phase A/B as forward and negative as backward. This cycle does not guess which wording matches runtime behavior.

evidenceBoundary: All roots are engineering/rendering/reference-implementation evidence rather than physical atmospheric Observation Roots. The UE sign conflict is itself evidence that raw phase parameters cannot be promoted without PhaseConventionIdentity and runtime/source calibration. SideFX and PBRT independently use positive-forward semantics, but they do not resolve UE runtime behavior.
